sents.t: Emma says, “Go to Lake Oakville, Sam. It is beautiful!” The lake is outside town.
It is too far to walk, so I take the bus.
The bus stop is on the corner of Maple Street and Main Street.
The number 12 bus comes every fifteen minutes.
I wait with an old man and a mother with a baby.
When the bus comes, I get on.
“How much is a ticket?” I ask the driver.
“Two dollars and twenty-five cents. You can pay with cash or with your phone.”
I pay with my phone and sit by the window.
The bus is clean and cool.
At every stop, a voice says the name of the street.
After twenty-five minutes, I hear, “Next stop: Lake Oakville.” I press the red button, and the bus stops.
The lake is blue and beautiful.
People swim, ride bikes, and have picnics.
I sit under a tree and read my library book.
In the evening, I take the bus home.
Now I know: the bus is easy!

comp.q: Where does Sam want to go?

o: on the corner of Maple Street and Main Street

comp.q: How often does the number 12 bus come?
comp.fa: اتوبوس شماره‌ی ۱۲ هر چند وقت یک بار می‌آید؟

comp.q: What does Sam do at the lake?
o: He has a picnic with Emma.
He reads a book under a tree.
comp.fa: سام کنار دریاچه چه کار می‌کند؟
